hypothesis.statement: On the VerbAgg Partial Credit Model benchmark (316 persons x 24 three-category items), pcm_measure's JMLE item locations and person measures reproduce the eRm CML reference (Spearman/Pearson agreement ~ 1.0), with a person separation reliability of ~0.86.

analysis_plan.dataset: lme4::VerbAgg, 316 persons x 24 three-category verbal-aggression items (a labelled stand-in for a polytomous ADL/IADL response matrix)

decision.threshold: descriptive: cross-engine agreement (item/person correlation vs eRm) + person separation reliability
